render_synthetic_rgb_silhouettes: render synthetic RGB images and silhouette masks from 3D OBJ mesh models using a soft renderer
render_optical_flow: render forward and backward optical flow fields between frames of a rotating 3D mesh sequence
export_camera_matrices: export camera rotation, translation, and intrinsic matrices as RTK text files for each rendered frame
export_mesh_cam_space: export camera-space mesh OBJ files for each frame after applying rotation and translation transforms
render_with_random_canonical: render synthetic data with randomized canonical space rotation applied to mesh vertices
